description:
Map.put(1, :a, 2) panics the runtime ('map put: expected a map, found ValueKind(13)' at runtime/src/heap/map_view.rs:70 on 44174db13; ir_runtime.rs:216 on d9c9a842c) where Elixir raises BadMapError with message "expected a map, got:

    1
". Survey every Map function and map primitive for its non-map behavior and raise BadMapError in Elixir's shape on interp, run and build, with an oracle fixture.
title: Map functions raise BadMapError for a non-map, as Elixir's do
